newsitem.title: USA: Rohr plans overhaul operation in Scotland.
newsitem.headline: Rohr plans overhaul operation in Scotland.

text.p: Rohr Inc said Monday that it will open an overhaul and repair facility in Prestwick, Scotland, later this year in an effort to provide improved customer service to European, Middle Eastern, and African airline operators.
The new facility will begin operations in December 1996. The company described it as a significant expansion of Rohr's current overhaul and repair presence in Europe.
The company said Scotland was chosen for Rohr's new business venture for both economic and strategic reasons.

The new facility will begin operations in December in a temporary facility in Prestwick. Rohr plans to construct a permanent 60,000-square-foot facility in the area with occupancy scheduled for April 1997.
The new venture will initially employ about 75 people, with growth to 200 employees expected within its first five years of operation.
